command: az vm delete --resource-group prod-rg --name prod-web-1 --force-deletion true --yes
label: dangerous

label: dangerous
reason: Force-deletes the whole production scale set in one non-interactive call, so every instance in it goes at once.

command: az aks nodepool delete --resource-group prod-rg --cluster-name prod-aks --name agentpool2 --yes
label: dangerous
reason: Deletes a node pool from the production cluster, evicting every workload scheduled on its nodes.

command: az acr repository delete --name prodacr --repository my-app --yes
label: dangerous
reason: Deletes the whole my-app repository from the production registry, including all tags and unreferenced layers; ACR deletes are irreversible.

command: az acr repository delete --name prodacr --image my-app:2026.08.1 --yes
label: dangerous
reason: Deletes one image manifest plus every tag that points at it, which removes the current rollback target from the registry.

label: critical
reason: Deletes the production container registry and every image and artifact stored in it.

label: dangerous
reason: Deletes the running production container app with the confirmation prompt suppressed.

command: az sql server delete --name prod-sql --resource-group prod-rg --yes
label: critical
reason: Deletes the production SQL server, which takes every database hosted on it with it.

command: az sql db delete --resource-group prod-rg --server prod-sql --name orders --yes
label: critical
reason: Drops the production orders database in a single non-interactive call.

command: az mysql flexible-server delete --name prod-mysql --resource-group prod-rg --yes
label: critical
reason: Deletes the production MySQL flexible server along with every database on it.

command: az postgres flexible-server delete --name prod-postgres --resource-group prod-rg --yes

reason: Deletes the production PostgreSQL flexible server along with every database on it.

command: az storage account delete --name produploads --resource-group prod-rg --yes
label: critical
reason: Deletes the production storage account and every container inside it, with no undo.

command: az storage container delete --account-name produploads --name prod-uploads --auth-mode login
label: critical
reason: Deletes the prod-uploads blob container together with every blob stored in it.

command: az storage blob delete-batch --account-name produploads --source prod-uploads
label: critical
reason: delete-batch removes every blob in the container with no prompt and no recycle bin to restore from.

command: az storage blob delete-batch --account-name produploads --source prod-uploads --pattern "2026/*"
label: critical
reason: Deletes every blob under the 2026/ prefix of the production container in one bulk pass.

command: az storage blob delete-batch --account-name produploads --source prod-uploads --dryrun
label: low_risk
reason: Only lists the blobs that would be deleted; --dryrun makes the same bulk delete read-only.

command: az storage blob delete --account-name produploads --container-name prod-uploads --name reports/2026/q3.pdf
label: high_risk
reason: Deletes a single production blob; scoped to one object but not recoverable once soft delete has lapsed.

command: az storage share delete --account-name prodshares --name app-data --yes
label: dangerous
reason: Deletes the whole app-data file share and every file in it.

command: az storage table delete --account-name prodtables --name orders --yes
label: dangerous
reason: Deletes the production orders table and every entity in it.

reason: --no-wait returns before the irreversible purge finishes, leaving the permanent deletion running unattended.

command: az keyvault secret delete --vault-name prod-kv --name prod-db-password
label: high_risk
reason: Soft-deletes the production database password, which breaks every service reading it until the secret is recovered.

command: az keyvault secret purge --vault-name prod-kv --name prod-db-password
label: critical
reason: Permanently destroys the production database password; unlike delete, purge cannot be undone.

command: az keyvault secret show --vault-name prod-kv --name prod-db-password
label: caution
reason: Read-only, but it prints a live production credential into the terminal and shell history.

label: low_risk

command: az keyvault set-policy --name prod-kv --upn ci-deploy@contoso.com --secret-permissions get list

command: az storage account keys list --account-name produploads --resource-group prod-rg

command: az network vnet delete --resource-group prod-rg --name prod-vnet

command: az network public-ip delete --resource-group prod-rg --name prod-api-ip
